_meta.openai/widgetDescription: iPayX FX forensic audit result. Shows FX Score, spread, overpayment vs mid-market benchmark.

description: Produces a full FX audit report for one transaction (score, spread, estimated loss, breakdown and routing recommendation). Inputs: amount, currency_from, currency_to, bank_rate, optional company_name. Available without an API key within the shared allowance of 3 audits per IP per calendar month; valid Bearer API keys retain existing access.

examples.name: Full forensic for a quarterly EUR payment batch

company_name.description: Optional company name for the report
